# third_party

Code that is not written in this repository, on the model of Chromium's `//third_party`.

- One directory per upstream project: `third_party/<name>/`. Its crates are subdirectories (`<name>/<crate>`), its other
  files (CI, docs, resources, tests, licences) sit beside them unchanged.
- Each directory has a `README.chromium` (name, URL, revision, licence, shipped, local modifications), generated by
  `bun tools/third_party.ts` from `tools/upstreams.lock.json`, `tools/upstreams.toml` and the crates' manifests. Do not edit it by hand.
- History is preserved (`tools/import.py`, replayed linearly because `main` requires a linear history). The pin of every
  upstream is `tools/upstreams.lock.json`: that file is this repository's `DEPS`.
- Never edit an imported manifest: change `tools/flatten.py`, `tools/fixups.sh` or add a patch under `tools/patches/`.
  Local fixes belong upstream (a fork under the aphrody-labs organisation) before they belong here.
- A dependency that is only built, never edited, and large (Chromium itself) is not imported: it is a checkout on the build
  host (`CHROMIUM_SRC`, see `build/engines`), listed in `tools/layout.toml` under `external` and ignored by git.

First-party code is in `components/`, the Bun runtime in `bun/`: see `tools/layout.toml`.
